shots.name: shot01_rasengan
shots.action: [Subject 1], the little wizard in the black Gryffindor robe with red lining and golden badge, raises his dark-brown wooden wand with one hand. A brilliant blue-white chakra orb (Rasengan) condenses and spins rapidly at the wand tip, humming with crackling energy, its glow reflecting across his glasses and robe. The robe flares in the swirling airflow. He wears a focused, determined expression. The camera slowly orbits and pushes in toward him.
shots.speaker: S1
shots.sound: crackling chakra energy, whooshing wind, cloth flapping

shots.name: shot02_shadowclone
shots.action: [Subject 1] brings both hands together around his wand, forming a hand sign. A burst of blue light and smoke erupts around him; three to four identical clones of himself appear, each in the same Gryffindor robe holding the same wand, arranged in a neat line. They turn in sync and raise their wands. The camera pulls back to reveal the row of clones.
shots.speaker: S1
shots.sound: energy burst, smoke puff, synchronized footsteps
